# Novadust

Novadust is a dark blue, high-contrast color theme with soft warm undertones, described for long writing and coding sessions. Notes are shown in rounded bento-box panels, and headings, lists, formatting and code blocks are color-coded for visual separation.

![Novadust screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mmartamg/novadust-obsidian/HEAD/novadust-img.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Novadust"
    author: "mmartamg"
    repo:   "mmartamg/novadust-obsidian"
    slug:   "novadust"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/novadust"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/mmartamg/novadust-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mmartamg/novadust-obsidian/HEAD/novadust-img.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark blue, high-contrast color theme with soft warm undertones for comfortable long writing and coding sessions. Display notes in modern rounded \"bento-box\" panels and color-code headings, lists, formatting, and code blocks for clear visual separation."
}
```
